content.title: PSL 2026 Points Table: Updated Standings, Results Of Pakistan Super League On April 19 after Zalmi beat Gladia
content.text: The Pakistan Super League (PSL) 2026, officially branded as HBL PSL 11, is the eleventh edition of Pakistan's premier Twenty20 cricket league. Organised by the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB), it marks a significant expansion from six to eight franchises, introducing two new teams: Hyderabad Kingsmen and Rawalpindi Pindiz. The tournament runs from March 26 to May 3, 2026, spanning 39 days with a total of 44 matches - 40 in the league stage and four in the playoffs (Qualifier, Eliminator 1, Eliminator 2, and Final). Defending champions Lahore Qalandars, led by Shaheen Shah Afridi, kick off the season against debutants Hyderabad Kingsmen at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. Due to regional geopolitical tensions and fuel constraints, the PCB revised the venues to just two cities: Lahore (Gaddafi Stadium) and Karachi (National Bank Stadium). All the matches of the PSL 2026 season will be played behind closed doors, and the final is set to be played in May.
